title: NotificationRequestObject
description: One of `meetingId`, `meetingNumber`, or `webLink` must be specified.

meetingId.description: Unique identifier for the meeting. Required if meetingNumber and webLink are not provided.

meetingNumber.description: Meeting number. Required if meetingId and webLink are not provided.

webLink.description: Link to a meeting information page where the meeting client is launched if the meeting is ready to start or join. Required if meetingId and meetingNumber are not provided.

announceAiNotification.description: Whether to announce the AI notification.
